sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Khalil,Mohd. Afzal Ansari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Harish Chandra Mishra
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Harish Chandra Mishra , learned counsel for the informant as well as learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant - Mohd. Taiyab with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. - 381 of 2018, under Sections - 420, 406, 467, 468, 471,
120-B IPC and Section 66 I.T. Act, Police Station -Mundali, District - Meerut, during pendency of trial.

3. Having heard learned counsel for the parties, at present:
(i) against FIR lodged on 27.7.2018, the applicant is in confinement since 28.3.2023;

sentences.text: (ii) the applicant claims to have cooperated in the investigation.

In that regard,
reliance has been placed on the anticipatory bail dated 3.2.2020 granted by this Court.

(iii) the applicant has no criminal history;
(iv) charge-sheet has already been submitted yet there is no hope of early conclusion of the trial;
(v) on prima facie basis, only for purpose of grant of bail, it has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant, dispute is purely civil.
Parties were known from before.
They had a running account.
In that context, it has been submitted, instead of resorting to arbitration for which agreement existed between the parties, false accusation has been made in the FIR.
In any case, the applicant is not shown to have offered any conduct as may doubt his intention to participate in the trial.

(vi) in any case, no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State and or the informant that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness.

4. In view of the above, without expressing any opinion on the final merits of the case, let the applicant involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail, on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressuring the witness, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
5. In case, of breach of any of the above conditions, the bail being granted shall be cancelled.
6. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the court concerned before the bonds are accepted.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Prakhar  Mohd. Taiyab vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191508978/
